hero.description: Fullstack Software Development Intern at Just. Exploring how engineering, artificial intelligence and business come together to build useful products.

work.title: Things I've built.
work.subtitle: A selection of professional and independent work.
work.analytics: An application that brings together digital presence metrics from Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics 4 and Zoho PageSense in one place.
work.barber: An appointment system that lets clients request bookings and barbers confirm them.
work.academic: An academic project in development using Java and Spring Boot.
work.minddrop: A collaborative arcade game built in C with Raylib, featuring boss battles, projectiles, power-ups and number-guessing challenges. My contributions included projectile firing and attribute drops.

about.title: Curiosity into craft.
about.description: My journey in software development has taken me through Estácio, where I studied with a ProUni scholarship, CESAR School and now Just, a legal technology company. I care about building useful software and understanding the problems behind it.

process.title: Engineering with AI in the loop.
process.description: I explore AI-assisted development workflows, including orchestrating specialized agents to collaborate on development tasks. The goal is to combine engineering judgment with new ways of building.
